_source: Phantasie III, DOS SSI 1988 (reverse-engineering/dos/phantasie3/extracted/, FORMAT.md): extracted/rule-tables.json (MAIN.EXE DGROUP, tools/scripts/extract_dos_p3_rules.py) and the specs named per block. Data for Core's III rules; nothing here is a formula.
_core_race: III race -> Core Race name, from the inverse of the I -> III transfer map DS:0x4e [C]. 5 (the 'Random' choice) and 16 (Elemental) have no Core member.

skills._note: The nine skills in record order (+0x30 + 4k value, +0x32 + 4k seed; FORMAT.md section 5) [C]. seed: '2*STAT+30' (root 0xa1f2); Fire Bow: 2*Level + 4*DEX + STR + 10, +30 Thief, +15 Elf (the manual's bonuses). table = the class table in skill_tables (training.md section 5).

skill_tables._note: C_k[class][level 1..15], III class order. DS:base + 15*class + level (1..15)

skill_table_fixes._note: D3-032 (user s82): five cells of skill_tables look like data errors (Thief Pick Lock L3, Ranger Attack L15, Ranger Parry L15, the Parry table one byte short so Monk / Wizard read a level ahead). These rows are Phantasie I's values, used by default; skill_tables as read is the p3.skill-tables = dos option.

hp_dice._note: levels 1..22; dice of rnd(3) at training, rnd(2) + 1 at creation; twice each L1-15 value = the manual's CON-10 HP chart; levels 1..22

training_xp_curve._note: G[level], need = (1000 * G[L] - 80000) / max(class score, 17) (training.md section 2). DS:0xb88 u32, index = level (0..21)

training_gold_curve._note: T[level], cost = T[L] * price_index * (20 - CHA)^2 / 100, 5..15000 (training.md section 3). DS:0xb6c u16, index = level; 16..20 overrun into the XP curve

max_level._note: training clamps the level at 21; level >= 21 cannot train (training.md section 1) [C]

spell_rows._note: DS:0x1208, 13 rows x 15 levels; class grouping [~] (manual match)

body._note: Six areas in record order (+0xf2 + 2k), states 0..3 [C] (FORMAT.md section 5, logic-specs/body-areas.md). hit_location rows: cumulative percent in the column order given (DS:0x12cc) [C]; for a character the column k maps to record area [0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1][k] (root 0xe9ee). tall_monster_ids: the first group's id that sets the 'tall' flag (root 0x104c0) [C] (44 is probably meant to be 43 Valley Giant [~]). limbless_monster_ids: injury messages say "'s body" for every area (0xe98c) [C].

hit_location_rows.use: melee hit; every monster hit on a character

social_classes._note: Creation (ovl2 0x227d) [C]: r = rnd(100) for races 0-4 (Human, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling), rnd(75) for the others; r < 30 Peasant, < 60 Labourer, < 90 Craftsman, else Noble. Starting gold in the bank = class * gold_per_class (FORMAT.md section 5.1). 4 Darklord / 5 Superhero are endgame titles (D3-006). D3-023 (user s81: manual): each level-up also pays class * gold_per_class (DOS pays nothing: an option, not built here). rules.json starting_gold is 0 for this reason.

class_kit._note: Every new (and transferred) character (ovl2 0x227d) [C]: carried [4, 22, bow, 64], all worn; bow 44 Short Bow for a Thief, else 41 Self Bow. first_spell by class (spell number; 0 = none).

score_weights._note: Quest bits 0..7 of record +0x8a; score = sum + level / 6 (endgame.md section 2). DS:0x1c50 u16 x 8

final_bosses._note: D3-024 (user s81): the party cannot Flee from these (Nikademus x2, Lord Wood); an option lets it. Monster ids.

found_items._note: D3-020 (user s81: manual 90; options unlimited, DOS 60)

roster._note: D3-029 (user s81: manual 'dozens' = no limit by default; DOS 20 records incl. the three elementals, so 17 characters, as an option).

wilderness_encounters._note: s83, root 0xde54 (logic-specs/encounters.md section 7) [C]: a step on any terrain but 10 / 8 / 15 fights when rnd(100) < chance; L = area_levels[x / 10 + 5 * (y / 15)] (root 0x1198); night encounters below night_below, then monster 12L + {0, 1, 4}; else kind 2 (12L + rnd(10) + 1) below kind2_below, kind 3 (12L + terrain_offsets[t + rnd(4)]) otherwise; ids > 74 or < 0 become 11, 61 becomes 60 (root 0xf143). Sleeping monsters below sleeping_below; the monsters notice the party when rnd(100) < 8L.

dungeon_entries._note: Entrance square (x, 0) of dungeon n (logic-specs/dungeon-events.md section 1 / 7) [C]: x = the record letter's entrance x (DS:0x1bb6); dungeon 1 enters at x 5 (FAR:0xe59a, ovl4 0x84e). Index = dungeon number - 1.

transfer_maps._note: I -> III (DS:0x48 class, DS:0x4e race), indexed by Phantasie I's number [C]

creation_age._note: Age and maximum age at creation, DOS ovl2 0x2691-0x2748 (MSEM87 float code, decoded s98) [C]: f = LCK (+0x14) times the race factor, stored as a single-precision float; races > 4 (every non-base race) f = f * 2.0 / 5.0; races 1 Dwarven and 4 Halfling f = f * 5.0 / 2.0 (a race-13 test there is dead code: 13 > 4 takes the first branch); race 2 Elven f = 19.0 * f; races 0 Human and 3 Gnome f unchanged. Maximum age +0x2a = trunc(f) (MS C _ftol root 0x3b2:0x2d9d); age clock +0x28 = trunc((rnd(7) + 24) * f + 260.0) in 1/26 year units. Keys are DOS race indexes (core_race). The maximum age is in I's lifespan steps of 256 units (human LCK 10: 10 steps, about 98 years) [~]; nothing in DOS reads it (D3-041).

armory_restock._note: D3-033 (user s89): the manual's 'stocks of weapons and potions can change each time the party enters', by Apple II's rule (side 1A town program lines 840-890) [C]: on each town entry 'wipes' times stock[rnd(0..wipe_ids-1)] = 0 (ids 0-110: equipment 1-100 and Healing Potions 101-110; repeats allowed), then 'picks' times stock[pool[floor((1 - r1*r2) * L * 3)]] = 1 (set, not add), L = the party's average level capped at level_cap, r1 / r2 uniform in [0, 1). pool = Apple II's 46 bytes LA+181..226, the same in every town file (found at disk 1A raw 0x46d8 and 30 more copies); positions 0..44 are reachable, the last byte (0) never. 'removed' (user s89): a pick landing on these ids (Light Key 172, Burnt Gem 155, positions 36-37) gives nothing, so the key stays a quest find. Apple II ids = DOS ids (155 Burnt Gem, 172 Light Key, 66 Staff, 105 Healing Potion 5 in items.json) [~]. Apple II skips the churn on the first entry after start / load (SA+1196) [~]; the remaster's new-game start does not run it either. DOS / Amiga: no restock (p3.armory-restock = dos).

town_entry_payout._note: D3-071, DOS ovl2 0x0000(1) on a paying town entry (s144 static [C]): before the found items' hand-out, ovl2 0x5a9 takes the last item with this id (180, the Wand of Nikademus) out of the found list for good (the list closes up, the found count -1; no quest bit, nothing else reads the slot). One per entry.

transfer._note: I / II -> III transfer (FORMAT.md section 6, DIFFERENCES-III D3-001...007, D3-016). DOS ovl1 after the creation routine [C]: social class 3 (Noble; the bank gold still comes from creation's own class roll), XP = xp_per_level * old level, bank gold += old bank gold / bank_gold_divisor, level 1 and dos_undead_level for Undead (DOS option; the manual's level 0 is the default). The wand (D3-001, Apple III's rule): if any source character's Phantasie I score is above wand_score_above, every transferred character carries wand_item and gets quest bit wand_quest_bit (DOS III's 'has the wand', dungeon-events.md section 4).
